title: Tidy up puts every terminal in one row of full-height columns, still free to move and resize
summary: Tidy up (button and Alt+T) now puts the visible terminals in one row of equal full-height columns in both project and eagle view, keeping order; parked terminals take no column.
lessons_learned: Layout stories in project view must treat parked terminals as hidden leaves: SplitPaneView hands a parked leaf's share to its sibling, so any 'equal columns' rule has to balance over visible leaves only (cost a review round here).
